name: Pier 39 upper deck galleries and stairs, south
note: 2026-10-17 (owner: "the second floor walkways are mostly continuous, with zany wood staircases going up and down"): the timber upper galleries along every OSM level-1 footway on the pier (the bake drew them flat among the shops; suppressed in public/patches/san-francisco.json), the stairs at OSM's highway=steps, the blue lamp posts, benches and barrel planters on the main walk. Data generated into pier39-style.ts (P39_GALLERY, P39_STAIRS, P39_FURNITURE) in this frame: x east, z north from this point. 'deck' in the name keeps the loader from clearing the ground under its 130 x 260 m box. Split in three parts by z (south < −60 ≤ middle < 35 ≤ north) so no one mesh passes the 25 000-triangle budget; this is the south part (the entrance to Building D).

name: Pier 39 upper deck galleries and stairs, middle
note: The same model as 'Pier 39 upper deck galleries and stairs, south', its the middle (−60 ≤ z < 35) part (Buildings C–G, O, P): pier39-style.ts pier39Galleries, split in three so no one mesh passes the 25 000-triangle budget. Same frame and base.

name: Pier 39 Flyer ticket kiosk
note: 2026-10-17, owner's photograph from the Embarcadero: a bright blue board-and-batten ticket kiosk with a curved blue roof, FLYER/TICKETS lettering, on the right as you come in (OSM node 11390824789 'Ride the Flyer'). Faces the walk (west).
